title: Dakota Johnson & Turnstile on ‘SNL’: Here’s Where to Watch ‘Saturday Night Live’ Online for Free
summary: Livestream the Fifty Shades of Grey actress host and Baltimore hardcore punk band perform on Saturday, Oct. 3 — watch live online for free.
contentText:

On Saturday (Oct. 3), Saturday Night Live returns with the second episode of season 52. The sketch comedy show taps Verity and Fifty Shades of Grey actress Dakota Johnson to host, while Baltimore hardcore punk band Turnstile serves as musical guest .

Get DirecTV 5-Day Free Trial

This is Dakota Johnson’s second time hosting, while Turnstile is making its SNL debut .

How to Watch ‘Saturday Night Live’ Live Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Oct. 3

- Network: NBC

- Host, Musical Guest: Dakota Johnson & Turnstile

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , Peacock

When Does ‘Saturday Night Live’ Start ?

SNL airs live on Saturday (Oct. 3), with a start time of 11:30 p.m. ET/PT.

What TV Network Features ‘Saturday Night Live’?

In 2026, SNL broadcasts on TV on NBC. Meanwhile, the variety sketch show is available to livestream on Peacock.

Who’s Appearing on ‘Saturday Night Live’ Tonight?

SNL is known for celebrity cameos during the show, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance. Since Dakota Johnson is hosting, it’s likely that Anne Hathaway and Josh Hartnett might appear.

Other artists who have been known to appear at SNL in the past, include Timothée Chalamet, Ben Stiller, Alec Baldwin, Mariska Hargitay, Meryl Streep, Harry Styles and others.

Where to Watch ‘Saturday Night Live’ Online for Free

For cord-cutters, there are a few ways to watch SNL online, if you don’t have cable, especially if you want to watch for free. DirecTV has a five-day free trial , while other streaming services, like Fubo and Hulu + Live TV , also offer free trials, so you can watch for free.
